preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(k, int) and 1 <= n <= 2*10**5 and 1 <= k <= 10**9 for n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is the length of the string (1 ≤ n ≤ 2*10^5) and k is the maximum number of operations (1 ≤ k ≤ 10^9).

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) for s, n, k in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string s consists of lowercase Latin letters and has length n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == n for output, n, k in zip(outputs, [n for n, k in test_cases]))
postconditions.description: The output string for each test case has the same length as the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in output) for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: The output string consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(output == s for output, s, n, k in zip(outputs, [s for s, n, k in test_cases]) if k == 0)
postconditions.description: If k is 0, the output string is identical to the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(output <= s for output, s in zip(outputs, [s for s, n, k in test_cases]))
postconditions.description: The output string is lexicographically smaller than or equal to the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(operations <= k for operations, k in zip([min_operations(output, s) for output, s in zip(outputs, [s for s, n, k in test_cases])], [k for n, k in test_cases]))
postconditions.description: The number of operations required to obtain the output string from the input string does not exceed k.

postconditions.expression: all(not exists_lex_smaller(output, s, k) for output, s, k in zip(outputs, [s for s, n, k in test_cases], [k for n, k in test_cases]))
postconditions.description: The output string is the lexicographically smallest string obtainable from the input string using at most k operations.
